name: repofind-delta
features: Alerts tab shows repo alerts filtered by category, with demo data until the backend is live.
Find tab searches repos by terms and language, and stumble runs a random search.
Watch and my list tabs save repos, with export as json, csv or clipboard.
Archive and Shodan tabs search, with stumble for random queries.
Catalog and site watch tabs add sites, check them and export all, and backup works.
